Read in data

data_full <- read_csv("data/cleaned_control_data.csv")

not_full <- read_csv("data/cleaned_sans_control_data.csv")

quality of samples

summary(data_full$duration_minutes)

    Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
    8.75    22.83    32.48   127.90    54.26 13975.55

who is my sample

gender, sexual ID

*don’t really have gender data for those excluded

state, county

state_percent_2020 <- read_csv("state_percent_2020.csv")

state_percent_2020 <- state_percent_2020 %>%
  mutate(
    percent_2020 = readr::parse_number(oct)
  )

view(state_percent_2020)

where <- data_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(state)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / nrow(data_full)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    state_percent_2020,
    by = "state"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
    delta = (percent - percent_2020)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

View(where)

where_appendix <- where %>%
  select(state, n, percent, percent_2020, delta) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(percent, 2),
    percent_2020 = round(percent_2020, 2),
    delta = round(delta, 2)
)
    

View(where_appendix)   

state_table <- where_appendix %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    caption = "Geographic Distribution of Survey Respondents Compared with the 2020 U.S. Population",
    label = "tab:state_distribution",
    col.names = c(
      "State",
      "N",
      "Sample (\\%)",
      "2020 U.S. Population (\\%)",
      "$\\Delta$ (p.p.)"
    ),
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header"),
    font_size = 9
  )

state_table

writeLines(
  as.character(state_table),
  "state_distribution_table.tex"
)
